note: Colorado PUC E-Filings, searchable from 1994 forward. Registered 2026-09-09 for item 7. Colorado matters for this project beyond its size: ten Colorado counties in data/county_aggregate.csv carry at least one recorded opposition event, and eight of the ten carry exactly one -- Denver at 3 and Logan at 2 are the only exceptions. A docket route here would deepen counties already visible at the thinnest possible margin rather than only adding new ones.
